feature_schema.name: age
feature_schema.label: Age
feature_schema.description: How old the patient is in completed years.

feature_schema.name: sex
feature_schema.label: Sex at Birth
feature_schema.description: Sex recorded in the medical dataset used by the screening model.

feature_schema.name: cp
feature_schema.label: Chest Pain Type
feature_schema.description: The type of chest discomfort reported during evaluation.

feature_schema.name: trestbps
feature_schema.label: Resting Blood Pressure
feature_schema.description: Blood pressure measured while the patient is resting.

feature_schema.name: chol
feature_schema.label: Cholesterol
feature_schema.description: Cholesterol level from the blood test.

feature_schema.name: fbs
feature_schema.label: High Fasting Blood Sugar
feature_schema.description: Whether fasting blood sugar is above 120 mg/dL after not eating for several hours.

feature_schema.name: restecg
feature_schema.label: Resting ECG
feature_schema.description: The result of the resting ECG (heart rhythm test).

feature_schema.name: thalachh
feature_schema.label: Maximum Heart Rate
feature_schema.description: The highest heart rate reached during the exercise test.
feature_schema.normal_range: 60-100 bpm resting; higher stress tolerance is typically favorable

feature_schema.name: exang
feature_schema.label: Chest Pain During Exercise
feature_schema.description: Whether exercise triggered chest pain symptoms.

feature_schema.name: oldpeak
feature_schema.label: ST Depression
feature_schema.description: A heart test measurement that shows how the ECG changes during exercise compared with rest.

feature_schema.name: slope
feature_schema.label: ST Segment Slope
feature_schema.description: The direction of the ECG line during peak exercise.

feature_schema.name: ca
feature_schema.label: Visible Major Blood Vessels
feature_schema.description: How many major heart blood vessels were visible during imaging.

feature_schema.name: thal
feature_schema.label: Thallium Stress Test Result
feature_schema.description: A coded result from a heart imaging stress test used in the source dataset.
